candidates.title: PDD: Unleashing Economical and Flexible Heterogeneous LLM Inference via Cross-Datacenter Prefill-Decode Disaggregation
candidates.reason: Cross-datacenter PD serving masks WAN KV transfer via RelayDecode and handoff to MainDecode; directly relevant to KV transport/disaggregation and heterogeneous infrastructure.

candidates.title: TokenWeave: Efficient Compute-Communication Overlap for Distributed LLM Inference
candidates.reason: MLSys 2026 distributed-inference work combines token splitting and fused AllReduce-RMSNorm using few SMs to overlap tensor-parallel communication; up to 29% latency and 26% throughput gains.

candidates.title: TokenDance: Scaling Multi-Agent LLM Serving via Collective KV Cache Sharing
candidates.reason: Collective KV reuse for synchronized multi-agent rounds plus block-sparse diff storage; reports 11-17x compression and up to 2.7x more concurrent agents.
